posts.content:
Waking up early in preparation for some quality camping world time.  Juntura is a dumpy expensive rv park.  

We were at camping world for probably 3 hours or so- maybe more.  We ended up leaving at 2.  But they fixed the air conditioner- it was a firefly issue.  

Drove to delco, ID.  Stayed at an rv park (village of trees).  It’s a big park and pretty nice.  We tentatively planned the rest of our stops to Owensboro.
